scientific_identity.main_innovation: causal representation and causal closed-loop experiment for robotic gas source localization

M1.name: PICR
M1.input: causal stamped gas+local-wind+pose history, geometry, sensor state, arbitrary source candidates
M1.output: source posterior, source-stable representation, nuisance representation, amplitude state, validity

M2.name: CPO
M2.input: source hypothesis, geometry, sparse local-wind history, causal gas/sensor state, future route intervention
M2.output: first-passage law, committor curve, marked log-ppm predictive law, validity/calibration

M3.name: PHS
M3.input: M1 posterior, M2 source-conditioned route laws, feasible equal-horizon routes
M3.output: selected route, normalized pairwise resolution, confusion diagnostics
